text:
olivia: quick follow-up from the Boreal dedicated outage postmortem. root cause: intermittent peering resets + on-prem NAT conntrack limit causing short isolation windows.
tom: captured BGP reset burst at 03:12 UTC, conntrack counters hit 65535 then started dropping established state.
anita: customer provided pcap and router logs (attached to INC-15155). infra-bot: jira/INC-15155 created: https://redwood/jira/browse/INC-15155.
sam: suggested mitigations: (1) runtime tolerant handshake with capped retries, (2) ops runbook for customers with conntrack ceilings, (3) customer liaison to request NAT tuning.
olivia: assign owners: tom -> network captures + carrier escalation (48h), anita -> customer liaison & preserve logs (72h), sam -> runtime mitigation PR + e2e (this week).
tom: I'll collect neighbor dumps and request carrier support. ETA 24h.
anita: customer agreed to keep router config for 72h and consider conntrack bump during maintenance window. I'll coordinate.
sam: runtime note: implement capped exponential with jitter and cap queued handshake attempts to avoid KV cache pressure. small snippet posted in PR.
olivia: observability: add an alert correlating peer_reset spikes with cache_evictions. owner: olivia -> create alert draft. ETA 3 days.
infra-bot: runbook stub created at https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated/boreal-peering-guidance.md. board linked: https://redwood/boards/remediations/INC-15155.
tom: recurring pattern: we've seen similar behavior with two other dedicated customers last quarter. recommend a shared mitigation template for carriers.
sam: agree. i'll start a short RFC for a runtime toggle that enables transient-peering-tolerance for affected customers.
olivia: close criteria: (A) customer confirms NAT change or maintenance, (B) runtime PR merged and rolled to canary, (C) alert validated in staging.
anita: will update INC-15155 with customer responses and maintenance window options.
tom: daily status updates here until all criteria met. :white_check_mark:
